body:
**Source:** split from #51 (Install skills and prompt templates from a package source); triage_version 2 files one ticket per area for tickets spanning 3+ areas.

**Files:** crates/trellis-loop/src/trust.rs; crates/trellis-loop/src/hooks.rs; crates/trellis-loop/src/registry.rs

ADR 0023's trust store covers repository hooks and tools. Code arriving in an installed package must not run until trusted.

**Acceptance:**
- Hook or tool code in an installed package is not loaded without trust, tested
- Trusting it records it in the trust store like repository items
- Existing trust tests pass

**Verify:** `cargo test -p trellis-loop trust`

## Decision
Refuse package code in the first cut: `trellis install` copies only `SKILL.md` trees and `prompts/*.md` and reports every other file it skipped; the trust store is untouched. Labels lowered (risk:high -> risk:medium, !security removed) because the owner decided this on 2026-09-28; that answer is the release, so `scripts/tickets/next.sh` may admit it. It stays under security review: see the last Done-when line.

Decided 2026-09-28 by the owner, via the coordinator.

## Done when
- Installing a package that contains hooks, tools or any other file copies none of them and prints each skipped path.
- The trust store file is byte-identical before and after an install.
- Two tests named `install_skips_code_*`: skipped paths reported; trust store unchanged.
- The security agent's checklist (`.claude/agents/security.md`) is run on the diff and every finding is resolved or filed as a ticket before merge.

## Verify
```
scripts/tickets/verify-tests.sh trellis-cli install_skips_code_ 2
```

Pre-check on drain 50b3295: exit 1

<!-- triage:start (generated; do not hand-edit) -->

## Tasks

- [ ] Include installed hook/tool code in the trust fingerprint
- [ ] Refuse to load it untrusted
- [ ] Test both paths
